proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ X φ c hm hn hc hi
  have h := MeasureTheory.mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => hn (X ω)) hi (φ c)
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hc]
  refine le_trans ?_ h
  rw [mul_comm]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hc.le
  refine MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono (fun ω hω => hm hω) (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : Ω → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), Monotone φ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) → 0 < φ c → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => φ (X ω)) P → P.real {ω | c ≤ X ω} ≤ (∫ ω, φ (X ω) ∂P) / φ c
